description: Defines the D3D11PictureBuffer class for managing Direct3D 11 textures and related resources in media GPU processing on Windows, including texture handling, reference counting, and output view acquisition.

classes.name: D3D11PictureBuffer
classes.description: A reference-counted class managing a D3D11 texture, its associated views, and related metadata for media processing on Windows.

methods.name: D3D11PictureBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the picture buffer with texture and metadata.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the buffer with GPU resources and callback.

methods.name: ProcessTexture
methods.description: Processes the texture to set up mailbox access and color space conversion.

methods.name: AcquireOutputView
methods.description: Acquires the output view for decoding.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the texture.

methods.name: in_client_use
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is in use by the client.

methods.name: in_picture_use
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is in use by the decoder.
